before: A press on text at an offset where control edges meet put the caret in the slot touching the text on the right, so pressing the end of a control's last word left the caret outside the control. splitContentControl divided only an inline control.
after: A press on text keeps the caret with the text it pressed. splitContentControl { controlId, at: { paragraphId, offset }, tag } divides a block control at a place strictly inside a paragraph it holds, cutting that paragraph when the place is inside it; the tail is a new control with the tag named and a fresh w:id.
reason: The press changes only where the caret stands, which no peer sees. The block split reduces to a paragraph split and one children replacement in the element holding the control, both of which the journal already replicates; released participants receive the resulting shared state, never the new op shape.
